goal: Expand Chu-kei Insight Plan Detection from the verified 25% milestone to full company-count coverage of the canonical universe. Prioritize breadth over depth: process every company in bounded resumable batches until no company remains not_checked. Preserve evidence boundaries and never infer a formal plan where official or first-party evidence does not support one.
graduation_criteria: Canonical universe coverage is complete: every company has been reviewed and the public summary reports not_checked=0, recalculated against the authoritative current universe.

Every non-not_checked disposition is supported by official or first-party evidence with source identity, dates or period semantics, provenance and review state; ambiguous evidence remains explicitly bounded rather than inferred.
Candidate generation, validation, review staging, promotion and derived registry/site rebuilds remain deterministic, resumable and compatible with required human-review gates.
Frontend manifest, Plan Detection summary and release metadata match canonical data, and repository-side sync, smoke, source-audit and quality checks are green.
Final repository and runtime verification are green and a concise completion marker records full-coverage counts, evidence boundaries and verification results.
